name: codealpha-rtc
description: Real-time communication app: E2EE chat, multi-user video calling, screen sharing, file sharing and a collaborative whiteboard.

scripts.dev: node init && docker compose up -d --wait mongo && pnpm --filter @rtc/server seed:if-empty && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.build: node init && pnpm --filter @rtc/web build && pnpm --filter @rtc/server build
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
